brief:
@buildthis.bisks.net mahjong solitaire aimed at intense accessibility particularly for older users

layering needs to be visually clear and apparent

rewind and restart features as well as backtracking level difficulty are all critical as well

mobile first aimed at older phones
note: built a mahjong pairs game: big tiles, tap-only (no dragging), no timer, undo/restart always on screen, and a "step down a level" button for when a board gets stuck. four levels, every deal is guaranteed solvable.
